title: Sheinbaum confirms APEC trip to China and a bilateral meeting with Xi; Trump meeting uncertain
detail: At her Nov 5 conference Sheinbaum said she will travel to China on Nov 15 for the APEC summit in Shenzhen (Nov 18–19), returning around Nov 20, and confirmed a bilateral meeting with Xi Jinping; agenda details are still pending. A meeting with Trump depends on whether he attends. She also said US immigration raids 'very likely' cost Republicans Latino votes in the midterms.

media.caption: Sheinbaum's Nov 5 morning press conference at Palacio Nacional
